claim: DNS Firewall Advanced protection detects suspicious DNS queries based on known threat signatures in DNS queries, such as DNS traffic associated with Domain Generation Algorithms (DGA) and DNS tunneling. Each rule in a rule group needs a single DNS Firewall Advanced protection setting, and the threat protection algorithms are managed and updated by AWS.

evidence.quote: Detects suspicious DNS queries based on known threat signatures in DNS queries. Each rule in a rule group requires a single DNS Firewall Advanced protection setting.
The threat protection algorithms are managed and updated by AWS.
DNS Firewall Advanced extends this capability by detecting and blocking DNS traffic associated with Domain Generation Algorithms (DGA) and DNS Tunneling threats.
